title: 第10章 绝不会是最后一次

content_zh:
一般说来，电视剧都是尽量争取棚拍，因为出外景的确非常费钱。再加上完善的劳工制度使得开夜景外拍的人工开销也大，所以珍妮可以在拍摄和餐馆工作中实现兼顾，当然，如此一来，她拿到角色的事再也瞒不过约翰尼，虽然老头子有些愁眉苦脸，但还是给珍妮开了方便之门。倒是杰西卡的脸色没那么好看了，珍妮也无心故意去撩拨她的心情，顶多就是这几天都绕着她走。
“说不定你就能一飞冲天了。”和她一同当班的凯文对此倒是很兴奋，“拜托，到时候回来吃饭的话多给我点小费。如果可以的话，雇我当你的助理吧，我会表现得很卖力的。”
他说话的声音大了点，杰西卡端着盘子走进后厨，哼了一声，美艳容貌稍微扭曲，露出了盛气凌人的女王派头——这是漂亮女孩的专利，“你倒是想得美。”
凯文不敢说什么，只是伸了伸舌头，珍妮也没理她，而是安静地吃着自己的午饭，对这样的人，连生气都是浪费精力。
现在是餐厅员工的吃饭时间，珍妮还是在吃自己的沙拉，而杰西卡虽然嘴上在和她赌气，但却也破天荒地没吃她喜欢的肉馅饼，而是模仿珍妮吃起了没油醋汁和沙拉酱的沙拉——基本就等于是一堆有点咸味的青草，外加水煮肉。珍妮看在眼里，不禁暗笑在心：杰西卡其实也算是有几分小聪明的了，只可惜她到底还是粗心了点，以至于走了最大的宝。
正这么想着，餐厅门口风铃响了，珍妮一看，顿时惊喜地放下午饭跑出员工休息区，“戴夫，你怎么来了？”
戴夫对她的热情很是受用，他有些羞涩地摸了摸后脑勺：“你知道巴菲就要开拍了，我下周本来也要再过来。”
所以他为了她的拍摄，特地提早来了一周？珍妮不知该怎么说了，“噢，戴夫，你真好！”
她不由分说地回厨房下了单，又拿了个好莱坞之星有名的魔鬼蛋糕外加大量奶油，“算在我头上。”
戴夫脸红了，他指着自己对面的座位，“方便吗？”
现在他是店里唯一的客人，珍妮耸了耸肩，“没问题。”
他们之前会固定通电话和传短信，所以戴夫知道她下周的排班，他关心她，“下戏就来餐厅这边，会不会太辛苦了？”
“两份钱可不好赚。”珍妮笑了，“放心吧，戴夫，为了五千美元，一周而已，我撑得过去的。”
她是真的很抱歉，“可惜这一周不能和你吃饭了，希望你开始工作以后不会太忙。”
“不不，不会。”戴夫开始脸红出汗，他清了清嗓子，躲避着珍妮的眼神：“事实上，我有个消息没告诉你……”
“是什么消息？”珍妮表面维持笑容，却是在心中暗叫：别求婚，拜托别求婚！
“我决定搬到加州来了。”戴夫说，“既然现在我开始负责巴菲的选角，那一年有一半以上的时间都会在好莱坞，维持纽约的家有些没有意义。以前一直住在纽约是因为——”
他挥了挥手，没提前妻的名字，而是出乎意料地大胆直视珍妮，“现在我没有理由再住在纽约了。”
“这真是个好消息！”珍妮松了口气，灿烂地笑着。
“我提早来还有一件事，”戴夫就像是一个小孩，在珍妮用笑容和鼓励堆砌的台阶上一步步往上走，不断吐露自己带来的好消息：“巴菲剧组决定在新一季里添加一个常规角色，但演员人选一直没定下来，我前些天已经向他们推荐了你。”

他微微向前倾身，似乎想要拿起珍妮的手，但犹豫了一下，终究没敢，“珍妮，辞掉餐厅这份工作吧，是时候彻底进入演艺圈了。”
珍妮完全不知道该说什么好了——她觉得自己真的很有运气，在这条路上走得的确很顺。
“我不知道我的演技——”中国人习惯难改，她先是自己谦逊了一句。
戴夫出人意料地点了点头，“这也是我之前没和你提起这事的原因，毕竟这是常规角色，而不是只出现几分钟的客串，不过之前你在CBS的试镜给我朋友留下了很深刻的印象，他认为你有这个实力试一试。”

content_en:
Generally speaking, TV dramas try to shoot in studios as much as possible, because shooting on location is indeed very expensive. In addition, the perfect labor system makes the labor cost of night scene shooting also high, so Jenny can balance the shooting and restaurant work. Of course, in this way, the fact that she got the role can no longer be hidden from Johnny. Although the old man looked a little frowning, he still opened the door for Jenny. However, Jessica's face was not that pretty, and Jenny had no intention of deliberately stoking her mood. At most, she just walked around her these days.
"Maybe you will be able to fly into the sky." Kevin, who was on duty with her, was very excited about this. "Please, give me a bigger tip when you come back for dinner. If you can, hire me as your assistant. I will work very hard."
He spoke a little louder, and Jessica walked into the kitchen with a plate and snorted, her beautiful face slightly distorted, showing the domineering queen style - this is the patent of beautiful girls, "You think beautifully."
Kevin didn't dare to say anything and just stuck out his tongue. Jenny ignored her and ate her lunch quietly. It was a waste of energy to even be angry with such a person.
It was now meal time for the restaurant staff, and Jenny was still eating her own salad. Although Jessica was quarreling with her, she did not eat the meat pie that she liked for the first time. Instead, she imitated Jenny and ate a salad without vinaigrette and salad dressing—basically a pile of salty grass and boiled meat. Seeing this, Jenny couldn't help but smile to herself: Jessica was actually a bit smart, but it was a pity that she was a little careless in the end and lost her biggest treasure.
Just as she was thinking this, the wind chime rang at the door of the restaurant. When Jenny saw it, she immediately put down her lunch and ran out of the employee rest area in surprise, "Dave, why are you here?"
Dave was very impressed by her enthusiasm. He touched the back of his head shyly: "You know Buffy is about to start filming, and I was supposed to come back next week."
So he came a week early for her filming? Jenny didn't know what to say, "Oh, Dave, you're so kind!"
She couldn't help but go back to the kitchen to place an order, and got a Hollywood star's famous devil's cake with a lot of cream, "It's on me."
Dave blushed and pointed to the seat opposite him, "Is it convenient?"
Now that he was the only customer in the store, Jenny shrugged, "No problem."
They had regular phone calls and text messages before, so Dave knew her schedule for the next week, and he cared about her, "Is it too hard to come to the restaurant after the show?"
"Two dollars is not easy to earn." Jenny smiled, "Don't worry, Dave, for five thousand dollars, it's just a week, I can handle it."
She was really sorry, "It's a pity that I can't have dinner with you this week. I hope you won't be too busy after you start working."
"No, no, no." Dave started to blush and sweat. He cleared his throat and avoided Jenny's eyes: "Actually, I have news that I didn't tell you..."
"What's the news?" Jenny maintained a smile on the outside, but secretly shouted in her heart: Don't propose, please don't propose!
"I decided to move to California," Dave said. "Now that I'm in charge of casting Buffy, I'll be in Hollywood for more than half the year, and it doesn't make sense to maintain a home in New York. I've been living in New York because—"
He waved his hand without mentioning his wife's name, but looked directly at Jenny unexpectedly and boldly, "Now I have no reason to live in New York anymore."
"This is really good news!" Jenny breathed a sigh of relief and smiled brightly.
"I came early for one more thing." Dave was like a child, walking up the stairs filled with smiles and encouragement step by step, constantly confiding the good news he brought: "The Buffy crew decided to add a new episode to the new season.A regular role, but the actor has not been decided yet. I recommended you to them a few days ago. "
He leaned forward slightly, as if he wanted to take Jenny's hand, but he hesitated and finally did not dare, "Jenny, quit your job in the restaurant, it's time to completely enter the entertainment industry. "
Jenny didn't know what to say at all - she felt that she was really lucky and that she was indeed going smoothly on this road.
"I don't know about my acting skills -" Chinese habits die hard, so she first modestly said it herself.
Dave nodded unexpectedly, "That's why I didn't mention this to you before. After all, this is a regular role, not a guest appearance that only appears for a few minutes. However, your previous audition at CBS left a deep impression on my friend, and he thought you had the ability to give it a try. "
